long_biography.plain_text:
Overvast became Marcus Fredericus Bakker's central operating platform when he joined its board in 2013. The Amsterdam group invests in and manages its own real estate. Subsequent demergers distributed property interests among Overvast Properties, Overvast Properties II and Max Euwe Properties, followed by the creation of Overvast Group.

Bakker also participates directly in development planning. At Max Euweplein, he represented Overvast in municipal design discussions concerning a mixed-use complex where the company owns much of the built space. The proposal combines improvements to the square with additional housing, illustrating a role that spans corporate direction, asset management and urban redevelopment.
